name: Agriculture problems
note: Curated list of agricultural problems grouped by type, using FAO and standard agronomy categories. Each entry searches the peer-reviewed literature.

groups.name: Abiotic stress
groups.query: KW:"Stress, Physiological" AND (plant OR crop) AND (drought OR salinity OR heat OR flood OR cold)

items.name: Drought stress
items.query: (KW:"Droughts" OR "drought stress" OR "water deficit") AND (crop OR plant OR agriculture)

items.name: Salinity stress
items.query: (KW:"Salt Tolerance" OR KW:"Salinity" OR "salt stress" OR "salinity stress") AND (crop OR plant OR soil)

items.name: Heat stress
items.query: ("heat stress" OR "high temperature stress" OR KW:"Thermotolerance") AND (crop OR plant OR agriculture)

items.name: Flooding and waterlogging
items.query: (flooding OR waterlogging OR submergence OR "anaerobic stress") AND (crop OR plant OR rice)

items.name: Cold and frost stress
items.query: ("cold stress" OR "frost" OR "chilling stress" OR "freezing tolerance") AND (crop OR plant)

items.name: Heavy metal toxicity
items.query: ("heavy metal" OR cadmium OR arsenic OR lead OR KW:"Metals, Heavy") AND (crop OR plant OR soil OR rice) AND (toxicity OR stress OR contamination)

items.name: UV and ozone damage
items.query: ("UV-B" OR ozone OR "tropospheric ozone") AND (crop OR plant) AND (damage OR stress OR yield)

groups.name: Soil problems
groups.query: (KW:"Soil" OR soil) AND (degradation OR erosion OR fertility OR acidity OR "organic matter") AND (crop OR agriculture)

items.name: Soil erosion
items.query: "soil erosion" AND (agriculture OR crop OR farmland OR conservation)

items.name: Soil fertility decline
items.query: ("soil fertility" OR "nutrient depletion" OR "soil organic matter" OR "soil health") AND (decline OR degradation OR management OR crop)

items.name: Soil acidity and aluminium toxicity
items.query: ("soil acidity" OR "acid soil" OR "aluminium toxicity" OR "aluminum toxicity") AND (crop OR plant OR agriculture)

items.name: Soil salinization and sodicity
items.query: ("soil salinization" OR "saline soil" OR "sodic soil" OR "salt-affected soil")

items.name: Soil compaction
items.query: "soil compaction" AND (crop OR agriculture OR tillage)

items.name: Soil microbiome and biofertilizers
items.query: (biofertilizer OR "plant growth-promoting" OR rhizobacteria OR mycorrhiza OR "soil microbiome") AND (crop OR agriculture)

groups.name: Pests
groups.query: (KW:"Insecta" OR pest) AND (crop OR agriculture) AND (damage OR control OR management)

items.name: Fall armyworm
items.query: ("fall armyworm" OR "Spodoptera frugiperda")

items.name: Bollworms
items.query: (bollworm OR "Helicoverpa armigera" OR "pink bollworm" OR "Pectinophora gossypiella")

items.name: Stem borers
items.query: ("stem borer" OR "Chilo partellus" OR "Scirpophaga incertulas" OR "yellow stem borer")

items.name: Aphids
items.query: (aphid OR Aphididae OR KW:"Aphids") AND (crop OR plant OR agriculture)

items.name: Whiteflies
items.query: (whitefly OR "Bemisia tabaci")

items.name: Thrips
items.query: (thrips OR Thysanoptera) AND (crop OR plant)

items.name: Locusts and grasshoppers
items.query: (locust OR "Schistocerca gregaria" OR "Locusta migratoria")

items.name: Fruit flies
items.query: ("fruit fly" OR Bactrocera OR Tephritidae) AND (fruit OR crop OR mango OR cucurbit)

items.name: Mites
items.query: ("spider mite" OR Tetranychus OR "eriophyid") AND (crop OR plant)

items.name: Storage pests
items.query: ("stored grain" OR "storage pest" OR "Sitophilus" OR "Tribolium" OR "Callosobruchus") AND (pest OR infestation OR damage)

items.name: Rodents and birds
items.query: (rodent OR rat OR bird) AND (crop damage OR "crop loss" OR agriculture OR grain)

items.name: Weeds
items.query: (KW:"Weed Control" OR weed OR "herbicide resistance") AND (crop OR agriculture)

groups.name: Water and irrigation
groups.query: (irrigation OR "water use efficiency" OR "water scarcity") AND (crop OR agriculture)

items.name: Water scarcity and groundwater depletion
items.query: ("water scarcity" OR "groundwater depletion" OR "groundwater decline") AND (agriculture OR irrigation OR crop)

items.name: Irrigation efficiency
items.query: ("drip irrigation" OR "micro-irrigation" OR "water use efficiency" OR "deficit irrigation") AND crop

items.name: Water quality and contamination
items.query: ("irrigation water quality" OR "wastewater irrigation" OR "fluoride" OR "nitrate contamination") AND (agriculture OR crop OR groundwater)

groups.name: Climate change
groups.query: (KW:"Climate Change" OR "climate change") AND (crop OR agriculture OR yield OR farming)

items.name: Climate change and crop yield
items.query: ("climate change" AND (yield OR productivity) AND (crop OR agriculture))

items.name: Climate-resilient agriculture
items.query: ("climate-smart agriculture" OR "climate resilient" OR "climate adaptation") AND (crop OR farming OR agriculture)

items.name: Greenhouse gas emissions from farming
items.query: (methane OR "nitrous oxide" OR "greenhouse gas") AND (rice OR livestock OR agriculture OR fertilizer) AND emission

groups.name: Post-harvest and food safety
groups.query: ("post-harvest" OR postharvest OR "food loss") AND (crop OR grain OR fruit OR vegetable)

items.name: Post-harvest losses
items.query: ("post-harvest loss" OR "postharvest loss" OR "food loss" OR "storage loss") AND (grain OR fruit OR vegetable OR crop)

items.name: Mycotoxins in food
items.query: (mycotoxin OR aflatoxin OR ochratoxin OR fumonisin) AND (food OR grain OR feed OR contamination)

items.name: Pesticide residues
items.query: ("pesticide residue" OR KW:"Pesticide Residues") AND (food OR vegetable OR fruit OR crop)

items.name: Fruit ripening and shelf life
items.query: ("shelf life" OR ripening OR "postharvest quality") AND (fruit OR vegetable) AND (storage OR coating OR ethylene)

groups.name: Inputs and sustainability
groups.query: (fertilizer OR pesticide OR "organic farming" OR "sustainable agriculture") AND (crop OR soil OR yield)

items.name: Fertilizer overuse and nitrogen pollution
items.query: ("fertilizer overuse" OR "nitrogen use efficiency" OR "nutrient runoff" OR eutrophication) AND (agriculture OR crop OR fertilizer)

items.name: Pesticide resistance
items.query: ("insecticide resistance" OR "pesticide resistance" OR "fungicide resistance") AND (pest OR crop OR agriculture)

items.name: Organic and natural farming
items.query: ("organic farming" OR "natural farming" OR "zero budget" OR agroecology) AND (yield OR soil OR crop)

items.name: Biopesticides and biocontrol
items.query: (biopesticide OR "biological control" OR Trichoderma OR "Bacillus thuringiensis" OR "neem oil") AND (pest OR disease OR crop)

items.name: Pollinator decline
items.query: (pollinator OR "honey bee" OR "bee decline" OR "colony collapse") AND (agriculture OR crop OR pollination)

items.name: Seed quality and germination
items.query: ("seed quality" OR "seed germination" OR "seed vigour" OR "seed vigor" OR "seed priming") AND crop

groups.name: Livestock and fisheries production
groups.query: (livestock OR dairy OR poultry OR aquaculture) AND (production OR productivity OR feed OR management)

items.name: Feed and fodder shortage
items.query: ("fodder" OR "feed shortage" OR "feed efficiency" OR "crop residue") AND (livestock OR cattle OR ruminant OR dairy)

items.name: Heat stress in livestock
items.query: "heat stress" AND (cattle OR dairy OR poultry OR livestock OR buffalo)

items.name: Antibiotic use in livestock
items.query: ("antimicrobial resistance" OR "antibiotic use" OR "antibiotic residue") AND (livestock OR poultry OR aquaculture OR dairy)

items.name: Aquaculture water quality and disease
items.query: (aquaculture OR "fish farming" OR shrimp) AND ("water quality" OR disease OR mortality OR ammonia)
